name: Oral Sex
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacredness of the marital union as a one-flesh relationship between a man and a woman, established by leaving parents and cleaving to one's spouse (Genesis 2:24). Sexual practices outside this God-ordained design, including those that distort the natural use of the body, are condemned as contrary to God's order (Romans 1:26). The holiness code in Leviticus further underscores the prohibition of sexual relations that deviate from this pattern, labeling them abominations (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). Wisdom literature highlights the inscrutable nature of certain behaviors, cautioning against deceit and moral compromise within relationships (Proverbs 30:18, 20).
